name: Toulon-Hyères

curfew.quote: pas de vols civils entre 2300 et 0700 locales ;

customs.v: On request, 24 h notice and GENDEC. Non-Schengen: Mon-Sat 08:00-20:00, Sun 08:00-19:00 local (07:00-19:00 / 07:00-18:00 UTC). Schengen: 06:00-21:00 local (05:00-20:00 UTC). Local times given for winter.

ppr.v: Military aerodrome, military traffic first. Civil aircraft over 3.5 t or 10 passengers need permission from the civil concession holder by email: 4 h notice for EU, Swiss, US or Canadian operators, 24 h for others.
ppr.quote: Les demandes d'autorisation sont à adresser au concessionnaire civil (par E-mail CIV) avec les préavis suivants :

fuel.v: Jet A1 for civil aircraft (F34 military).

notes: Read AIP France AD 2 LFTH (Hyères Le Palyvestre), eAIP 06 Aug 2026 (older than the edition in force; the current page could not be opened). Military base with civil use: send the PPR and GENDEC early. Customs hours are given in UTC; summer local times are one hour later.
